title: Uniform lower tensor bound for proper-support direct image
statement: Let S be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], let f:X\to S be a morphism locally of finite type, and let E be an object of D(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. Assume E is bounded with coherent cohomology sheaves, every cohomology sheaf of E has support proper over S [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], and E has finite Tor dimension as an object of D(f^{-1}\mathcal O_S). Then there is an integer a such that for every quasi-coherent structure-sheaf module F on S and every i<a, H^i(Rf_*E\otimes^L F)=0 [def-pc-derived-tensor-cohomology-vanishes].

source.place: Tag 08EV, lemma-perfect-direct-image, proof: quasi-compact support reduction and final projection-formula lower-bound argument (uses Tags 08EU and 08DZ)

proof.text: By [lem-pc-direct-image-qc-support-reduction] (S Noetherian, f locally of finite type, E bounded with coherent cohomology whose cohomology sheaves have support proper over S) there is a quasi-compact open immersion j:X'\to X containing all supports of the H^i(E) with f'=f\circ j quasi-compact and quasi-separated and Rf'_*j^*E\cong Rf_*E. The hypotheses on E pass to j^*E (restriction to an open is exact and j^{-1}f^{-1}\mathcal O_S=f'^{-1}\mathcal O_S, so the finite Tor interval [a,b] of E over f^{-1}\mathcal O_S is one for j^*E). Replace X,f,E by X',f',j^*E.

Let F be a quasi-coherent O_S-module. By [lem-pc-kflat-bounded-flat-replacement] (with N=0) choose a complex P of flat O_S-modules with P^i=0 for i>0 and a quasi-isomorphism P\to F. By [lem-pc-flat-complex-derived-pullback] Lf^*F is represented by the termwise pullback f^*P, which is K-flat over O_X by [lem-pc-bounded-above-flat-kflat] and [lem-pc-kflat-pullback-preservation]; so E\otimes^L_{O_X}Lf^*F is computed termwise by E\otimes_{O_X}(O_X\otimes_{f^{-1}O_S}f^{-1}P)=E\otimes_{f^{-1}O_S}f^{-1}P (associativity of the tensor product). The terms f^{-1}P^i are flat f^{-1}O_S-modules (stalks (f^{-1}P^i)_x=P^i_{f(x)} over (f^{-1}O_S)_x=O_{S,f(x)}), so f^{-1}P is K-flat over f^{-1}O_S by [lem-pc-bounded-above-flat-kflat] applied on the ringed space (X,f^{-1}O_S), and f^{-1}P\to f^{-1}F is a quasi-isomorphism since f^{-1} is exact. Hence E\otimes^L_{O_X}Lf^*F\cong E\otimes^L_{f^{-1}O_S}f^{-1}F, which by the finite Tor-dimension hypothesis has cohomology only in [a,b], with a\le b independent of F.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Lemma 36.27.1 (Tag 08EV), the identity Lf^*F tensor E = f^{-1}F tensor_{f^{-1}O_S} E (Cohomology, variant derived pullback)

proof.text: Coherence implies quasi-coherence. Derived pullback and tensor preserve quasi-coherent cohomology. For quasi-coherent F, apply the derived projection formula to identify Rf_*E tensor^L F with Rf_*(E tensor^L Lf^*F). Step 2 gives the latter input cohomology zero below a. Compute the right-derived direct image with a bounded-below K-injective resolution zero below a; termwise direct image remains zero in those degrees. Thus the output has zero cohomology below a, uniformly in F. Transport the result through the support-reduction isomorphism and express it using a K-flat representative and the derived-tensor vanishing predicate.

theorem exists_schemeDerivedDirectImage_tensor_lower_bound
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E))
    (hcoherent : ∀ i : ℤ,
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E))
    (hsupport : ∀ i : ℤ,
      Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj E))
    (hTor : HasFiniteTorDimensionOver f E) :
    ∃ a : ℤ, ∀ F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace),
      F.IsQuasicoherent → ∀ i : ℤ, i < a →
        schemeDerivedTensorCohomologyVanishes S ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E) F i
